notes: Consumes only durable non-secret formalism receipts and owner work manifests.
The heartbeat adapter exposes only a sandbox-local mirror of the bounded state root; the authoritative host path is not passed to the worker.
External state projection requires the same current claim/fencing token and is restricted to outbox/inbox/processed relative paths.
No GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, PAT, TVC_EPHEMERAL_GITHUB_TOKEN, provider secret, or wallet secret is accepted or forwarded.
TVC remains the sole credential authority and must independently authorize each operation.
